title: Sales By Customer figures do not change with the new wording
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Today customer {Customer-A} has one invoiced part sale of $40.00 and one invoiced work order of $250.00 that includes a part.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Select only Part Sales and read {Customer-A}'s row.
  2. Select only Service Sales and read {Customer-A}'s row.
  3. Select both and read {Customer-A}'s row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it holds only the part sale, $40.00.
  • Step 2: it holds only the work order, $250.00, including the part sold on it.
  • Step 3: it holds both, $290.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R10: “What each option includes does not change. "Part Sales" are invoices from part sales. "Service Sales" are invoices from service work orders, including the parts sold on them.”
  • S8-N1: “No Sales By Customer figure, row or count changes because of the new wording.”
